pipelineObservation.observedPipeline: Browser Three.js HTML prototypes under prototypes/fighter/
pipelineObservation.sourceAssetPolicy: null means no current Unreal/Niagara asset was evidenced; docs, icons, and skill specs are not executable VFX assets.
pipelineObservation.performancePolicy: Only values explicitly declared in prototype HTML are recorded. They are browser-prototype expectations, not UE runtime or Niagara measurements.

statusTaxonomy.EXISTING_EXACT: Dedicated prototype directly corresponds to this current FormId.
statusTaxonomy.EXISTING_SHARED: Prototype is shared across forms or multiple branch prototypes serve this single current FormId; every FormId remains a separate entry.
statusTaxonomy.NEEDS_SPLIT: Existing prototype lacks an authored branch for a materially distinct current form and needs future physical split.
statusTaxonomy.LEGACY_NAME_MATCH: Only a legacy-named VFX prototype matches; current name/FormId remains canonical.
statusTaxonomy.MISSING: No execution VFX prototype/asset corresponding to this FormId in this snapshot.
statusTaxonomy.NOT_APPLICABLE: No execution VFX is applicable to the form.
